actions: Reconstructed the predecessor exact-curtailment/tail-floor continuation under the frozen control tuple.
Computed exact binomial tail probabilities, curtailed within-candidate stopping laws, all-null stream survival, and exact negative-binomial-mixture q95 pair cost for fixed rho=.20.

Swept q95 budgets 300-3500 across r in {10,20,30,50}; generated mixed-depth deterministic policies with target-power/Pareto search and direct budget-constrained local search; exact-evaluated all reported policies.
Compared mixed-depth policies against fixed-depth maximin/reference families, preserving the single-good q=.60 worst-position objective and FWER<=.05.
Persisted the new role-local checkpoint and advanced role-local LATEST with exact readback blob.

outputs.material_result: Mixed depth creates a large observed mid-budget power bridge after exact curtailment. At q95=1941 an r30:k23 x18 then r50:k36 x2 schedule has exact worst-position q=.60 true-commit 0.0416317 and FWER 0.0484578, versus 0.0171830 for the best fixed-depth policy affordable below a 2000-pair q95 budget. Observed relative gains remain large through budgets 2250-3250, but vanish at the 1000-pair fixed-r20 point and the 3389-pair fixed-r50 endpoint.
outputs.scope_note: Operating characteristics of listed policies are exact under the stated model; global optimality of the mixed-depth q95 frontier is not certified because policy proposal used Pareto pruning/local search.

termination.cause: physical invocation boundary after substantive checkpoint; not research completion
termination.exact_next_action: Build a distribution-aware branch-and-bound/DP over stopped-cost and surviving-prefix distributions to certify the best attainable worst-position q=.60 power at q95 budgets 1800, 2000, 2500, 3000 and 3250 under rho=.20, then extend certified winners to rho uncertainty.
